entries.subject: North Central Health Care (CCN 524017) - machine-readable file last_updated_on date
entries.body:
Hello,

Hope you're doing well! I took a look at your hospital price transparency files and I wanted to flag something on North Central Health Care's machine-readable file.

The file is up and loading fine with no access issues. However, the `last_updated_on` value in it reads 2024-01-19, which as of today is 952 days ago (about 2 years, 7 months).

A few details in case they're useful:

* CCN: 524017
* Pointer file: https://www.norcen.org/cms-hpt.txt
* MRF: https://machine-readable-files.com/north-central-health-care/930801810_North-Central-Health-Care_standardcharges.csv
* CMS template version: 2.0.0
* Checked: 08/27/2026 6:18 PM EST

For reference, 45 CFR 180.50(b)(2) requires hospitals to update the standard charge file at least once annually and to indicate the date of the last update. Going by the January 2024 date, the annual refresh would have been due 01/19/2025, so it's currently about 19 months past that point, with two annual cycles in between.

Is a refresh already in the works or has the file perhaps been republished somewhere else that the pointer file hasn't caught up with? Happy to correct my records if I'm looking at the wrong copy.

I'll plan to check back around September 27 to see how things are going. Wanted to be upfront that if the file still shows a January 2024 date at that point, I'll likely need to flag the annual-update requirement to CMS.

Thanks so much and let me know if I've got the wrong copy of the file or if there's anything else I can pass along.

Best,
Anthony
m***@anthonyisnota.dev
